product_evaluation_context.evaluation_purpose: Test the strong compact-selection thesis for one named role, pool, horizon and hiring capacity.

question_or_hypothesis: The three-session policy reaches a predeclared absolute selection-quality floor, is non-inferior to the longer pipeline and superior to an equal-time structured comparator without unacceptable fairness or access costs.
conditions: Freeze role, pool, horizon, capacity, margin and outcome before recruitment
Blind independent outcome assessors where possible
Hold out employers, time and case families
Keep experimental score out of initial hiring decisions

variables_or_interventions.name: three-session assessment
variables_or_interventions.planned_value: At most three recorded case answers, each at most ten minutes

variables_or_interventions.name: equal-time method comparator
variables_or_interventions.planned_value: Structured work sample or interview under the same candidate-time budget

environment: Prospective, permissioned employer cohorts; exact employers and jurisdictions open.
stop_rules: Use preregistered stopping and analysis rules
Pause on significant access or data-protection failure
limitations: No sample size or power result
No study run or observed effect
claim_ceiling: Draft prospective design only; no validation, recruitment or employer-use authority.
